title: Transcendence degree in a field tower
statement: Let $k\to K\to L$ be homomorphisms of fields, with the $k\to L$ map their composite. For the transcendence degrees [def-kun-transcendence-degree], one has $\operatorname{trdeg}_k L=\operatorname{trdeg}_K L+\operatorname{trdeg}_k K$, with cardinal addition (and hence ordinary addition when the degrees are finite).
